title: Resolved Addresses: Only show wka actually used in the capture
description:
For well-known addresses, store whether the address has actually
been used in a lookup or is just present in the global file.
In the Resolved Addresses dialog, only display the well known
addresses that have actually been looked up.

Part of #13857
